تساهلت (form VI)
# تَسَاهَلْتُ (tasāhaltu) /ta.saː.hal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# تَسَاهَلْتَ (tasāhalta) /ta.saː.hal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# تَسَاهَلْتِ (tasāhalti) /ta.saː.hal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَاهَلَ (tasāhala)
# تَسَاهَلَتْ (tasāhalat) /ta.saː.ha.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
